sources.title: Reuters exclusive: Trump administration drafting ban on Chinese datacenter devices (optical transceivers)
sources.author: Reuters (via Bloomberg Law, Seeking Alpha, Invezz); market colour supplied by user
sources.notes: FCC drafting an import ban on NEW MODELS of Chinese optical transceivers for US datacenters (stated rationale: data theft/malware/service disruption); officials hope to publish within 2026, but it could be modified or shelved. Chinese vendors >50% of the global DC transceiver market (Bloomberg); InnoLight ~27% alone (Counterpoint). Foundation for American Innovation: Coherent and Lumentum sell competitive tech but lack scale to replace Chinese supply. Same window: NVDA co-packaged optics confirmed in MASS PRODUCTION, and Nokia — $4B US R&D/manufacturing commitment, ~$1B Nvidia stake, AI sales +49% q/q, optical networks +20% — rallied ~5%.
